subject: Re: Zenova trial planning - infra choice & owners
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zenovahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 16:22:00 +0000
Subject: Zenova trial - options and quick follow-up

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned before we lock the trial: 

Summary from our side:
- Primary goal: validate clinically safe redaction + 95% intent accuracy on patient routing use case (see success criteria attachment).
- Traffic profile: expect ~2k requests/day during trial window, 95th latency target <= 300ms for single-turn queries.
- Data controls: PII retention should be disabled; all logs must be encrypted and retained for 30 days.

Trial hosting options we discussed (attached comparison):
1) Hosted API (fastest, lowest friction) — good for feature validation, no VPC.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU capacity) — predictable throughput, customer data isolation within Redwood infra.
3) Private VPC deployment (customer-managed VPC) — required if Zenova's security team needs HSM/KMS in their cloud and strict network controls.

What we need from you to pick initial path:
- Security preference: Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC (Priya, looping you in for security questions).
- Minimum success criteria confirmation (I've attached a draft .xlsx).
- Target go/no-go date for trial decision (we suggested 2026-12-22 on call).

Proposed next steps (short timeline):
- By Mon 12/13: Zenova confirms hosting choice + signs mutual action plan.
- Wed 12/15: Redwood provides trial SOW draft + provisioning ETA.
- Week of 12/20: Environment ready; 2-week trial starts.

I'll prepare a short mutual action plan and SOW draft (attaching options & success criteria). Rishi — can you confirm estimated spin-up time for Dedicated vs VPC?

Thanks,
Grace
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_trial_options_comparison.pdf, zenova_trial_success_criteria.xlsx

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zenovahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenovahealth.com>, Mark Rueda <mrueda@zenovahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zenova trial - options and quick follow-up

Grace —

Thanks for the concise summary. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Security: initial preference is Dedicated sandbox. Our security team is open to VPC, but there are additional procurement gates that will slow us down; Dedicated gives the isolation we need without extra procurement cycles.
- Success criteria: Alyssa confirms the intents list in the spreadsheet; one addition: 'redact PHI in 99% of cases for free-text notes' — I've added that to the sheet.
- Timeline: 12/22 decision is aggressive but doable if we get the SOW and action owners this week.

Priya — can you confirm if Dedicated sandbox is acceptable from a compliance viewpoint or if you want us to require VPC?

Mark — I'll coordinate procurement expectations if we proceed with Dedicated.

Alyssa
Director of Product | Zenova Health
alyssa.chen@zenovahealth.com

> On Thu, Dec 10, 2026 at 16:22 Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Thanks again for the call today...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zenovahealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Zenova trial - infra choice & owners (technical notes)

Hi all —

Technical notes and rough provisioning estimates: 
- Hosted API: provisioning immediate; no network setup required. Works for quick feature validation but limited for strict egress/kms controls.
- Dedicated sandbox: typical spin-up ~3 business days once commitment is signed; we can reserve a 1-GPU worker pool for your throughput profile. Can enable per-customer KV cache segregation and disable persistent logs on request.
- Private VPC: dependency on Zenova infra team. Estimated 2-3 weeks for networking, peering, and KMS/HSM integration; includes mutual security review.

Edge cases for success criteria:
- PHI redaction 99%: we should agree on test prompt set and measurement approach (Rishi to own test harness).
- Latency target: 95th <= 300ms depends on sequence length distribution; we should capture a sample payload set.

I recommend starting with Dedicated sandbox to meet security needs and speed, with an option to migrate to VPC if procurement requires later. If Zenova signs commitment by 12/13 we can have Dedicated ready by 12/16.

I'll attach a short tech checklist for onboarding (network rules, sample payloads, key rotation window).

– Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: onboarding_tech_checklist.txt

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zenovahealth.com>, Mark Rueda <mrueda@zenovahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: Zenova mutual action plan + SOW draft (for review)

Alyssa / Mark —

Per Rishi's note, attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP) and an SOW draft outlining provisioning assumptions for a Dedicated sandbox trial. Highlights: 
- Decision: Dedicated sandbox as default path unless Priya flags VPC requirement.
- Owners: Zenova owner = Mark Rueda (procurement), Zenova security = Priya Singh. Redwood owners: Grace (AM), Rishi (SE), David (support/ops).
- Timeline:
  - 12/13: Zenova confirms Dedicated and returns signed MAP.
  - 12/16: Redwood provisions Dedicated sandbox environment.
  - 12/20–1/03: 2-week trial window.
- Success criteria (as finalized): intent accuracy >= 95%, PHI redaction >= 99%, 95th latency <= 300ms, no unauthorised data egress.

Please review the attached SOW_draft_v1.pdf for billing and terms. Mark — if procurement needs a formal PO rather than MAP, flag that and we will convert immediately.

Next step for us: I'll update MAP with signatures and submit SOW for your review by EOD Wednesday.

Grace

Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf

From: Mark Rueda <mrueda@zenovahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zenovahealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenovahealth.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zenova mutual action plan + SOW draft (for review)

Grace / team —

This looks good. We confirm Dedicated sandbox as our preferred path. Procurement will need the SOW converted to a PO template; Alyssa and I will send that back by Friday 12/17. Priya has reviewed at a high level and is comfortable with Dedicated pending the onboarding checklist; she asked us to capture the key rotation window and log retention explicitly in the SOW (noted).

We accept the success criteria as written and will provide a sample payload set by Monday 12/20.

Mark
VP, Program Delivery | Zenova Health
mrueda@zenovahealth.com
